title: Side-by-Side Pricing Plans: How to Display on Web Pages
text:
## Side-by-Side Pricing Plans: How to Display on Web Pages
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000073080
Websites powered by Brilliant Directories have a default pricing page that utilizes the basic webpage text editor to display membership plans in a modern, vertical format. This, however, requires users to scroll down the page to compare plans.
The Side-by-Side Pricing Plan feature provides an alternative horizontal column layout for the pricing page, making it easier to compare the membership plans.

## What It Looks Like By Default:
When using the Side-By-Side Pricing Tables, the information can be updated and edited via the Pricing Page Menu Toolbox » Menu Manager » then edit/customize the "Pricing Page Menu"
* The Pricing Page menu is not automatically updated according to the Membership Plan settings. Manually edit the text that will be displayed here via the Menu Manager.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12087520494/original/c6opO5c5taLQC5cGuSWXWPSRH1bRe1WfbA.png?1610747409 | alt: ]

## How To Add This To A Web Page:
1. Go to Toolbox » Menu Manager »  Find the "Side by Side Pricing Menu" and h over over the ACTIONS button and click on the Copy to Clipboard option. Then paste the copied shortcode for this menu directly into a web page.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180541620/original/HctVOcZtMgkvWRY1taTvRRHSAvVBq5fRBw.png?1781642054 | alt: ]
2. Paste the copied shortcode and add it to an existing web page or create a new one in the Content »  Web Page Builder section of the admin.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180541634/original/lMSeW_w-MNtV63OzN66BEOk6_7zsYWrrig.png?1781642114 | alt: ]
